items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: He and Louie was close friends, and Paul Bond was close friends.

ctx.x: We'll check that out. Yeah. We talked about Manuel Mineta. He was Secretary of the Union, you said.

Yes. He was Secretary of the Union. He lived over in Algae. And Paul Barnes carried me over to his house. Mm-hmm. Made me acquainted with him. And he said he would like to get me into the Union. And during that time, only the New Orleans musicians had a Union card. You could go all over to Louisiana, you wouldn't find any musicians with a Union card. And Paul D. Barnes' whole band, we didn't have a Union card. And so, he took me over to Manuel Mineta's home. And I didn't have the dollar. So, he loaned me the…
